pages.text: A vat only counts machines that sit $(item)directly on its top layer$() or $(item)directly under its bottom layer$(), inside its footprint.

$(li)$(item)Industrial Mixer$(): on top, in the $(item)centre$() of a 3x3 vat (anywhere on top of a smaller one). Give it a $(item)Mixer Blade$() for mixing or a $(item)Centrifuge$() for centrifuging by right-clicking. Driven from its top shaft, it needs at least $(item)30 RPM$().

$(li)$(item)Electrode Holder$(): on top, powered through its $(item)top face$(). Right-click it with an electrode, sneak-click with an empty hand to take it out. It needs at least $(item)5 A$() (server config).$(li)$(item)Compressor$(): on top or underneath, driven by a horizontal shaft at $(item)120 RPM or more$().
$(li)$(item)Freezer$(): on top or underneath, powered by electricity on any side, it needs $(item)more than 3 A$() (75 ohm, so above 225 V).
A mixer without its item or a holder without an electrode is simply not counted. The build shown here is the classic 1x1 mixing vat: a firebox for heat, the vat, and a mixer on top.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
